title: No bulk actions on scope items during audit execution — every control requires individual drawer open + save cycle
description:
Re-verified 2026-08-22 — narrower than originally described. A true multi-select bulk-assign DOES exist, but only in the pre-audit configuration phase (`config/RequirementsConfigTab.jsx:76-99`, with `handleSelectAll`/`handleSelectOne` checkboxes feeding `BulkAssignmentModal`). In the actual execution-phase requirements list auditors use day-to-day (`ConfiguredRequirementsContent.jsx`), the equivalent modal (`selectedControls`/`isAssignModalOpen` state, lines 235-236) is only ever invoked with a single record (`handleToggleScope`, lines 660-679, calling `setSelectedControls([record])` to restore one out-of-scope item) — there is no way to select multiple already-configured rows to bulk-update status, assign auditors, or attach evidence during execution; each control still requires opening its own drawer.

Claude Fix Prompt:
```
Fix D-29 in ConfiguredRequirementsContent.jsx. Add row checkboxes to the execution-phase requirements table (reuse the multi-select pattern already built in config/RequirementsConfigTab.jsx). On selection, show a bulk action toolbar: "Assign to..." (user picker), "Set Status..." (limited to transitions valid for ALL selected items via the workflow engine), "Mark Not Applicable..." (bulk justification modal). Apply via a single bulk-update API call.
```

There IS a separate, non-breadcrumb `<Text>{auditInfo.name}</Text>` heading rendered just below the breadcrumb bar (lines 1048-1054), so the audit name is visible on the page somewhere — but the breadcrumb trail itself, which is what the defect specifically calls out (for distinguishing multiple open audit tabs), is unchanged and still generic.

Change the 'Requirements' crumb to interpolate auditInfo.name, e.g. { label: auditInfo?.name || 'Requirements', isCurrentPage: true }, or add an intermediate crumb for the audit name before a final static 'Requirements' crumb.
